motifs.name: upper_sheer_cliffs_pine_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the high upper-right mountain mass: sheer pale vertical cliff faces, rounded summit ledges, dark stippled contour dots, dry-brush crevices, cascading wash streaks, and the dense ridge of upright conifers along the top and right slope. Exclude the red seal and the nearby cliffside pavilion.
must_preserve: pale vertical wash texture on the cliff faces
dark dotted moss texture along ridge edges
thin angular rock linework
clustered pine trunks and needle strokes on the summit
soft misty gaps around the cliff edges

motifs.name: cliffside_pavilion_tower
motifs.description: Isolate the small multi-level pavilion embedded in the upper central cliffs, including its stacked roofs, balcony railings, supporting posts, warm brown architectural accents, and the immediate enclosing trees and rock ledges that frame it. Do not include the larger surrounding mountain mass beyond the local ledge.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with upturned eaves
fine balcony and railing linework
brown-red color accents on walls and posts
dark conifer needles behind and below the pavilion
small adjacent rock ledge texture

motifs.name: middle_left_cliffs_conifer_ledges
motifs.description: Isolate the stepped middle-left cliff system with pale faceted rock planes, narrow terraces, and dense vertical conifer groves growing along ledges. Include the dark moss-dot outlining and striated rock washes, but exclude the large foreground pine canopy and the upper pavilion tower.
must_preserve: layered cliff-face brush lines
dry-brush vertical fissures
moss-dot texture along ledge rims
slender pine trunks with clustered dark needles
mist-softened distant rock silhouettes at the left edge

motifs.name: right_mid_village_huts_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the small village cluster at middle right: low thatched and tiled huts, simple fence lines, pale wall rectangles, surrounding pines and soft trees, and the misty ground plane beneath the cliffs. Avoid including the large courtyard building below.
must_preserve: thin roof-line geometry of the huts
light wall washes and small doorway marks
woven or fenced detail between buildings
dark pine silhouettes behind the village
soft mist edge separating village from cliffs

motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right waterside pavilion compound with tiled roofs, open colonnades, interior scholar figures, table furnishings, surrounding trunks, shrubs, and rocky terrace. Include the small gate-like structure at the lower right if connected to the compound, but exclude the bridge and river crossing.

crisp beam, post, and railing linework
small scholar figures with robes and gestures
table and interior furnishing details
tree trunks rising in front of the architecture
rock terrace texture and dotted foliage accents

must_preserve: gnarled trunk contours
branching calligraphic linework

motifs.description: Isolate the central arched wooden bridge crossing the water, including its railings, vertical supports, stone footings, two travelers, the horse, and the immediate bridge reflections or water ripples directly beneath. Do not include the large courtyard or the surrounding cliffs except where bridge supports touch them.
must_preserve: curved bridge profile
thin railing posts and crossbars
wooden pier bundles and stone bases
traveler robes and hats
horse outline and harness details
short ripple lines under the bridge

motifs.name: lower_riverbank_rocks_leafless_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right riverbank scene with pale rippled water, scattered dark rocks, the low rocky shore, and gnarled leafless trees leaning over the water. Exclude the bridge above and the red seal at the bottom edge.
must_preserve: fine horizontal water ripple lines
dark isolated rock shapes in the stream
gnarled bare branch linework
